def affichage():
    i = 0
    f = open("arithmetique.dat", "rb")
    eof = False
    win.table.setRowCount(0)
    while not eof:
        try:
            e = load(f)
            win.table.inssertRow(i)
            win.table.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["a"])))
            win.table.setItem(i, 1, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["b"])))
            win.table.setItem(i, 2, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["pgcd"])))
            win.table.setItem(i, 3, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["ppcm"])))
            win.table.setItem(i, 4, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["puis"])))
            win.table.setItem(i, 5, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["fact"])))
            win.table.setItem(i, 6, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["cnp"])))
            win.table.setItem(i, 7, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["prem"])))
            win.table.setItem(i, 8, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["fprem"])))
            i += 1
        except:
            eof = True
        f.close()
